```{r}
# install.packages(c(
#   "ggalluvial", "GGally", "ggcorrplot", "tidytext", "ggwordcloud"
# ))
# 
# remotes::install_github("ricardo-bion/ggradar")
# remotes::install_github("https://github.com/davidsjoberg/ggstream")
library(scales)
library(ggstream)
library(ggalluvial)
library(ggradar)
library(GGally)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(tidytext)
library(ggwordcloud)

library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(ggthemes)
```


```{r}
socviz::election |> select(state, total_vote,
                           r_points, pct_trump, party, census)
```


```{r}
election24 <- socviz::election24
```

```{r}
library(socviz)
```


```{r}
party_colors <- c("#2E74C0", "#CB454A")  # Hex color codes for Dem Blue and Rep Red
p0 <- ggplot(data = filter(election, st != "DC"),
             mapping = aes(x = r_points,
                           y = fct_reorder(state, r_points),
                           color = party))
```


```{r}
p1 <- p0 + 
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0, 
    color = "gray30") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Point Margin", 
       y = NULL)

p1
```



```{r}
party_colors <- c("#2E74C0", "#CB454A")  # Hex color codes for Dem Blue and Rep Red
p0 <- ggplot(data = filter(election24, st != "DC"),
             mapping = aes(x = r_points,
                           y = fct_reorder(state, r_points),
                           color = party))
```


```{r}
p1 <- p0 + 
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0, 
    color = "gray30") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Point Margin", 
       y = NULL)

p1
```

```{r}
p2 <- p1 + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = party_colors)

p2
```
```{r}
p3 <- p2 + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 
      c(-30, -20, -10, 0, 
        10, 20, 30, 40),
    labels = 
      c("30\n (Clinton)", "20", "10", "0", 
        "10", "20", "30", "40\n(Trump)")
    )
p3
```

```{r}
p3 + 
  facet_wrap(~ census, 
             ncol=1) +
  guides(color = "none") + 
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size=8)
    )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
p3 + 
  facet_wrap(~ census, 
             ncol=1,
             scales = "free_y") +
  guides(color = "none") + 
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size=8)
    )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
# install.package("ggforce")
library(ggforce)

p3 + 
  facet_col(~ census, 
            scales="free_y", 
            space = "free") +
  guides(color = "none") + 
  labs(x = "Point Margin", y = "",
       title = "Presidential Election in 2024") +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=6),
        strip.text=
          element_text(size=rel(.6))
        )
```




```{r}
# install.packages("maps")
us_states <- map_data("state") # from the 'maps' package
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  data = us_states,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat,
                group = group))

p + geom_polygon(
  fill = "white", 
  color = "black")
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  data = us_states,
  aes(x = long, y = lat,
      group = group, 
      fill = region))

p + 
  geom_polygon(
    color = "gray90", 
    linewidth = 0.1) + 
  guides(fill = FALSE)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  data = us_states,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat,
                group = group, 
                fill = region))
p + geom_polygon(color = "gray90", 
                 size = 0.1) +
    coord_map(projection = "albers", 
              lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) +
    guides(fill = FALSE)
```

```{r}
election <- election |> 
  mutate(region = str_to_lower(state))

us_states_elec <- us_states |>
  left_join(election)
```


```{r}
p0 <- ggplot(
  data = us_states_elec,
  aes(x = long, y = lat,
      group = group, 
      fill = party))

p0 + 
  geom_polygon(
    color = "gray90", size = 0.1) +
    coord_map(projection = "albers", 
              lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) 
```

```{r}
p1 <- p0 + 
  geom_polygon(color = "gray90", size = 0.1) +
  coord_map(projection = "albers", 
            lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) 

p2 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors) +
  labs(title = "Election Results 2016", 
       fill = NULL)

p2
```

```{r}
p2 + theme_map()
```



```{r}

election <- election24 |> 
  mutate(region = str_to_lower(state))

us_states_elec24 <- us_states |>
  left_join(election)

p0 <- ggplot(
  data = us_states_elec24,
  aes(x = long, y = lat,
      group = group, 
      fill = party))

p0 + 
  geom_polygon(
    color = "gray90", size = 0.1) +
    coord_map(projection = "albers", 
              lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) 

p1 <- p0 + 
  geom_polygon(color = "gray90", size = 0.1) +
  coord_map(projection = "albers", 
            lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) 

p2 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors) +
  labs(title = "Election Results 2024", 
       fill = NULL)

p2 + theme_map()
```

```{r}
p0 <- ggplot(
  data = us_states_elec,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat, 
                group = group, 
                fill = pct_trump))

p1 <- p0 + geom_polygon(color = "gray90", size = 0.1) +
    coord_map(projection = "albers", 
              lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) 

p1 + labs(title = "Trump vote",
          fill = "Percent") + 
  theme_map()
```



```{r}
p2 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", 
                      high = "#CB454A") +
        labs(title = "Trump vote",
             fill = "Percent") 
p2 + theme_map()
```

```{r}
p0 <- ggplot(
  data = us_states_elec,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat, 
                group = group, 
                fill = d_points))

p1 <- p0 + 
  geom_polygon(color = "gray90", size = 0.1) +
  coord_map(projection = "albers", 
            lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) 

p2 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_gradient2() + 
  labs(title = "Winning margins",
       fill = "Percent") 
p2 + theme_map()
```
```{r}
p3 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red", 
    mid = scales::muted("purple"),
    high = "blue", 
    breaks = c(-25, 0, 25, 50, 75)) 

p3 + theme_map() + 
  labs(fill = "Percent", 
       title = "Winning margins")
```


```{r}

us_states_elec_no_DC <- us_states_elec |> 
    filter(region != "district of columbia")

p0 <- ggplot(
  data = us_states_elec_no_DC,
  aes(x = long, y = lat, 
      group = group, 
      fill = d_points))

p3 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red", 
    mid = scales::muted("purple"),
    high = "blue") 
p3 + theme_map() + 
  labs(fill = "Percent", 
       title = "Winning margins", 
       caption = "DC is omitted.")
```


```{r}
# socviz::county_map

county_map <- socviz::county_map

county_data <- 
  read_csv("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/socviz_county_data.csv")

county_full <- county_map |> 
  left_join(county_data, 
            by = c("id" = "fips"))
```



```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  data = county_full,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat,
                fill = pop_dens_disc, 
                group = group))
p1 <- p + 
  geom_polygon(color = "gray90", size = 0.05)
p1
```


```{r}
p1 + coord_equal()
```



```{r}
p2 <- p1 + coord_equal() + 
  scale_fill_brewer(
  palette = "Blues",
  labels = c("0-10", "10-50", "50-100", "100-500", "500-1,000", "1,000-5,000", ">5,000"))

p2
```


```{r}
p2 + labs(fill = "Population per\nsquare mile") +
  theme_map() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  data = county_full,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat, 
                fill = hisp_disc, 
                group = group))
p1 <- p + 
  geom_polygon(color = "gray90", size = 0.05) +
  coord_equal()
p2 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Greens")

p2 + labs(fill = "US Population, Percent Hispanic") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) + 
  theme_map() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  data = county_full,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat, 
                fill = black_disc, 
                group = group))
p1 <- p + 
  geom_polygon(color = "gray90", size = 0.05) +
  coord_equal()
p2 <- p1 + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Greens")

p2 + labs(fill = "US Population, Percent Black") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) + 
  theme_map() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
orange_pal <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 6, name = "Oranges")
orange_pal
```


```{r}
orange_rev <- rev(orange_pal)
orange_rev
```


```{r}
pop_p <- ggplot(
  data = county_full,
  mapping = aes(x = long, y = lat,
                fill = pop_dens6, 
                group = group))

pop_p1 <- pop_p + 
  geom_polygon(color = "black", size = 0.05) +
  coord_equal()

pop_p2 <- pop_p1 + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = orange_pal)

pop_p2 + 
  labs(title = "Population Density",
      fill = "People per square mile") +
  theme_map() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
pop_p2_rev <- pop_p1 + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = orange_rev)

pop_p2_rev + 
  labs(title = "Reverse-coded Population Density",
       fill = "People per square mile") +
  theme_map() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
